build.// development: Internal dev client builds — install on a real iPhone/Android, then `npx expo start --dev-client` connects Metro for hot reload. Same workflow as the simulator but on real hardware.
build.// development-simulator: Variant for iOS Simulator — useful when you don't have a physical device or want to test in a controlled environment. Otherwise identical to development.
build.// preview: TestFlight internal track / Play Internal Testing. Release builds (optimised JS) signed for distribution. Send this to the seed lawyers + the operating attorney for sign-off before App Store submission.
build.// production: App Store / Play Store submission builds. AAB for Android (Play requires App Bundles). Auto-increment build numbers via the remote version source.

submit.// production: Auto-submission to TestFlight + Play Internal. Fill in appleId + ascAppId + sku after Apple enrollment; serviceAccountKeyPath after Play Console setup.
